phase: Phase 3: The track A review set and the scorer (by Thu 2026-11-19)
summary: Round 2 of the security review. All five round 1 findings that task 3.12d fixed are closed at f497917. leak-check reads each staged name byte-exact with `-z`, so a non-ASCII name, a name with a space, and a staged rename each give exit 2. The private-path check holds the realpath of a symlinked --private, and a broken docs symlink exits 0 with no crash. All five write paths refuse a planted symlink at the target and on an ancestor inside the named root before any write, and the outside file stays unchanged. All four write tools refuse a set id that is not a plain name. The six single-file suites pass at HEAD (13, 19, 18, 25, 20, 2 tests). One Nit stays open and no blocker or Major remains.
nonblocking_findings: P3B2-1 [Nit] review-b: nothing enforces the D9 order of the key SHA-256. review-set.ts:551 still computes key_sha256 from the key bytes at lint time, and adjudicate.ts:437-444 rewrites the key files after the lint. A lint run before the apply publishes a hash that the apply invalidates. This carries round 1 finding P3B1-6; Green 3.12d changed no code here, and review A carries it as P3A2-6. The phase plan controls the order at task 4.13: the apply runs first, then the lint runs again, then the orchestrator commits the manifest. Non-blocking.

Test K4 pins the non-ASCII case and passes in leak-check 13/13.

F2 (P3B1-2) withdrawn: every write path refuses a symlink with lstat before mkdirSync and writeFileSync. The guards are review-set.ts:511, review-score.ts:451, adjudicate.ts:283 (queue), 382 and 383 (verdicts and real-defects), 439 (key write-back), and pick-diffs.ts:299. writePath lists the target and every ancestor inside the named root. F3 (P3B1-3) withdrawn: leak-check.ts:224 builds privatePaths from the given string, resolve(), and realOf, which is realpathSync with a fallback. Probe: with --private as a directory symlink to the real private folder, a staged file that holds the real absolute path exits 2 with `leak-check: private-path: path.txt`. Test K3 pins the case and passes.

F4 (P3B1-4) withdrawn: filesUnder uses statOf, which returns null for a broken link and skips it (leak-check.ts:140-160). Probe: a broken symlink under docs/ exits 0 with no output. Test K5 pins the case and passes.

F5 (P3B1-5) withdrawn: the four write tools each check the set id with SET_ID_RE and refuse `set-id: <value>` before any write (review-set.ts:169-174, review-score.ts:97-101 and 168, adjudicate.ts:98-102, pick-diffs.ts:88-92). The character class holds letters, digits, `.`, `_`, and `-`, needs a letter or digit first, and bars `..`. The pinned tests pass in review-set 18/18, review-score 25/25, adjudicate 20/20, and pick-diffs 19/19.

F6 (P3B1-6) not withdrawn: task 3.12d changed no code for the key SHA-256 order, so the Nit is re-raised as P3B2-1 above. The practical risk is bounded because the plan runs the apply before the second lint and before the manifest commit (task 4.13).

The fake gh of the test fixture exits 3 on any other verb, and the pick-diffs suite passes 19/19.

Public content: the manifest holds only set_id, created, and per diff id, repo, commit, parent, seeded_sha256, and key_sha256, plus the plant counts (review-set.ts:542-554); the score file holds set_id, passes, and routes with no finding text, file, or line (review-score.ts:527-534); queue.json, verdicts.json, real-defects.json, and the key write-back land under <private>/sets/<set_id>/adjudication or keys (adjudicate.ts:281-282, 380-381, 438); the candidates land under <private>/candidates (pick-diffs.ts:298). review-prompt.md holds no witness, new_lines, or operator word.

Every write command requires an explicit --private or --repo and refuses an empty or flag-shaped value: leak-check.ts:80-81, review-set.ts:227, review-score.ts:165-167, adjudicate.ts:160-162, pick-diffs.ts:143-145. Each suite pins the needs-a-value refusal lines.
